metadata.protocol: Use all 102 previously frozen residual inputs, preserving their recorded seeds and order. Generate complete branch-instance signature columns. For q=2,3,5,7 in that order, seek a functional zero on each column and one on the all-ones target. Retain the first independently verified certificate. If none is found, report that outcome without inferring feasibility. The independent checker regenerates every injective branch assignment and imports no discovery code or third-party package. A separate global permutation oracle checks exact completion for every input. No selection uses new outcomes and there is no timing comparison or novelty claim. Separately count certificates with every branch table nonempty, and certificates where every target resource occurs in some local option; this distinguishes missing-resource exclusions from parity obstructions with full local coverage.
